subject: SummitOps renewal — hosted tier cadence + burst-pocket exchange
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Liam Porter <liam@summitops.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Jul 2025 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: SummitOps renewal — hosted tier cadence + burst-pocket exchange

Hi Liam —

Great to hear SummitOps is looking ahead on the renewal. Attached is a short proposal that reflects the two levers we discussed on the call: 1) a 12-month committed uplift (higher monthly tokens) in exchange for a lower per-token rate, and 2) a dedicated burst pocket for seasonal traffic spikes that won’t impact the committed throughput.

Key highlights (summary):
- Committed monthly: 150M tokens / month (12-month term)
- Unit rate: $0.0008 per infer token (tiered steps above commit)
- Burst pocket: 25M tokens/month available at a slightly higher rate but guaranteed for 72-hour bursts
- Soft throttle guardrails and per-route quotas to protect latency SLOs

I put numbers in the attached spreadsheet and included our updated rate card (PDF). If this model looks reasonable I can loop in Finance for standard T&Cs and Legal to prep a DocuSign that preserves the burst pocket as an addendum.

Next step: quick sync this week to lock numbers? I’m available Tue/Wed mornings PT.

Cheers,
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.com
From: Liam Porter <liam@summitops.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Cc: Sana Kapoor <sana.k@cloudops.io>
Date: Sat, 12 Jul 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SummitOps renewal — hosted tier cadence + burst-pocket exchange

Hi Naomi —

Thanks for the proposal and summary. Quick questions:
1) Can you hold the 150M commit for 14 months instead of 12 if we take a 10% prepayment?
2) How does the burst pocket interact with our two high-traffic routes (ingest-api & search-rerank)? Need guaranteed spare capacity so those routes don’t degrade during campaigns.

Sana and I will review the spreadsheet but want to make sure the burst behavior is per-route configurable. If yes, I think we can tighten the term.

—Liam
Liam Porter, Head of Product — SummitOps
liam@summitops.com
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Liam Porter <liam@summitops.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Jul 2025 10:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SummitOps renewal — hosted tier cadence + burst-pocket exchange

Liam —

Short answers:
- We can extend to 14 months with a 10% prepayment (Finance OK with that; I’ll attach alternate term in the spreadsheet).
- Burst pocket can be split across routes. We model the pocket as an allocator: up to 25M/month split by route with route-level floor guarantees so search-rerank can reserve a minimum allotment during campaign windows. There are two implementation options:
  A) static route partitions (reserve X for search-rerank, Y for ingest-api), or
  B) dynamic allocator with priority token siphoning plus a per-route minimum guard.

I’m looping in Karthik and Marcus — they’ll confirm ops/throughput feasibility and whether we should make the burst pocket a separate billing bucket (recommended) to avoid confusing usage spikes with commit utilization.

Next: can we lock a 30-min sync Tue 10:00 AM PT?

Best,
Naomi
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam Porter <liam@summitops.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SummitOps renewal — hosted tier cadence + burst-pocket exchange

Team / Liam —

Thanks for laying out the ask. Quick operational notes from infra:
- We can support a 14-month prepay schedule with separate accounting for the burst pocket. Billing will create a distinct "burst" bucket so it does not decrement committed quota.
- Implementation plan for route protection: we recommend option B (dynamic allocator) with a small static minimum for search-rerank (default 6M/month) to guarantee campaign headroom.
- Latency: to preserve p99 SLOs we’ll pin search-rerank on the low-latency pool during bursts; ingest-api can be routed to a mixed pool when utilization is high. There is an ops playbook we’ll add to the renewal addendum.

Marcus — can you confirm the estimated incremental GPU commitment needed to support the burst cushion during multi-day campaigns? If so we’ll include the GPU reserve line in the commercial.

Karthik
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam Porter <liam@summitops.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Jul 2025 08:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SummitOps renewal — hosted tier cadence + burst-pocket exchange

Karthik / Naomi —

Estimated reserve: to guarantee the 25M/month burst pocket with a 72-hour continuous window we recommend adding a soft GPU reserve equivalent to ~2 x A100 peak slices during heavy campaign days. That maps to an incremental cost line (~$9,400/month) that I flagged in the proposal spreadsheet under "infrastructure reserve."

I also added language for automatic fallback: if the burst bucket is exhausted we will redirect new burst traffic to a lower-priority queue (no functional regressions; slightly higher latency).

If SummitOps is comfortable with the incremental reserve we’ll show two commercial variants on the DocuSign: (A) 14mo prepay with 10% discount, (B) 12mo pay-as-you-go with smaller upfront and higher per-token rate.

Marcus
Senior Product Ops — Redwood Inference
From: Liam Porter <liam@summitops.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Cc: Sana Kapoor <sana.k@cloudops.io>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Jul 2025 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SummitOps renewal — hosted tier cadence + burst-pocket exchange

Naomi —

Thanks — the model looks sensible. We prefer option A (14mo prepay with 10% discount). Please send the DocuSign with the burst-pocket addendum + the static minimum for search-rerank set to 6M/month. Also include the infrastructure reserve line in the commercial.

Sana will be the signatory; please copy our procurement alias procurement@summitops.com on the DocuSign.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Liam

--
Attachments referenced: SummitOps_Renewal_Proposal_2025.xlsx, redwood-rate-card-v3.pdf
